lines.en: There’s this tree I walk past some nights when I don’t know what to do with myself.
lines.zh: 有些夜晚,我不知道该拿自己怎么办,就会走过一棵树。

lines.en: I guess you can probably surmise I’ve visited it a lot with that in mind.
lines.zh: : 由此推测,我拜访它的次数应该不少。

lines.en: For the first few years, it was merely coincidental.
lines.zh: : 头几年,那纯属巧合。

lines.en: Just a thing I’d pass by on my way from one place to the next.
lines.zh: : 只是我从一处走向下一处时,路过的东西。

lines.en: But it’s changing now — and so am I.
lines.zh: : 但它正在改变——我也是。

lines.en: It’s started to blossom.
lines.zh: : 它开始开花了。

lines.en: This is spring, after all. It was only a matter of time until that scent and those colors found their way back to me.
lines.zh: : 毕竟是春天。那股香气、那些颜色,迟早会重新找到我。

lines.en: Just like she did.
lines.zh: : 正如她当年那样。

lines.en: I keep thinking I’ll see her beneath it — standing there with her palm outstretched, hoping the wind sodomizes the branches and delivers a petal or two to her fingers.
lines.zh: : 我总以为会在树下见到她——掌心向上摊开,盼着风蹂躏树枝,送一两片花瓣到她的指间。

lines.en: There’s nothing ever there, though. Because she only visits me when I don’t want her to.
lines.zh: : 但树下从来空无一人。因为她只在我「不」想见她的时候出现。

lines.en: Sometimes I’m just lonely, though.
lines.zh: : 不过,有时候我只是孤单。

lines.en: Sometimes, I just miss her.
lines.zh: : 有时候,我只是想她。

lines.en: That’s okay, right?
lines.zh: : 这没关系,对吧?

lines.en: My phone goes off in my pocket.
lines.zh: : 手机在口袋里响了。

lines.en: It’s like a portable, hand-held god.
lines.zh: : 它就像一台便携的、掌上的神。

lines.en: : Hello?
: Hey, Akira. Any chance you could meet up tonight? There’s something I want to talk to you about.
lines.zh: : 嘿,Akira。今晚有概率见一面吗?有件事我想和你聊聊。

lines.en: : Am I allowed to know what it is beforehand? Or is this one of those things where I get blindsided by drama and thrown into a lake of sorrow where I must either sink or swim?
lines.zh: : 我有资格提前知道是什么吗?还是说,这又是那种「被剧情偷袭、被扔进悲伤之湖,不沉底就得扑腾」的事?

lines.en: : Lake of Sorrow is an album by Sins of Thy Beloved.
lines.zh: : 《Lake of Sorrow(悲伤之湖)》是 Sins of Thy Beloved 乐队的专辑。

lines.en: : Cool. That doesn’t answer my question, though.
lines.zh: : 酷。但这没回答我的问题。

lines.en: : It’s about Rin. Just come over and I’ll tell you more, okay?
lines.zh: : 是关于 Rin 的。你过来,我再细说,好吗?

lines.en: : Rin? Did something happen to her? Is everything-
lines.zh: : Rin?她出什么事了?一切都——

lines.en: : Just come over...and I will tell you more. Okay?
lines.zh: : 你过来……我再细说。好吗?

lines.en: : Oh...yeah. I’ll head over now.
lines.zh: : 哦……好。我这就过去。

lines.en: : Bring cheese, if you can. It’s important.
lines.zh: : 顺便带点奶酪,如果方便的话。这很重要。

lines.en: : You don’t...still have that rat. Do-
lines.zh: : 你不会……还养着那只老鼠吧。难——

lines.en: : Bye, Akira! See you soon!
lines.zh: : 拜拜,Akira!回头见!

lines.en: Rika hangs up the phone and I have no intention to deliver cheese to her house.
lines.zh: Rika 挂断了电话,而我完全没有往她家送奶酪的打算。

lines.en: Not because I’m evil, though. My evilness has no relation to the amount of cheese I am capable of transporting.
lines.zh: : 不是因为我邪恶。我的邪恶程度,与我所能运输的奶酪总量毫无关联。

lines.en: I’m just a little worried, that’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是有点担心,仅此而已。

lines.en: But I guess there’s a baseline of permanent worry when it comes to Rin since I’ve seen firsthand what she’s done to herself in the past.
lines.zh: : 但说到 Rin,常年挂着一条基础焦虑线也是难免的——毕竟她过去对自己做的事,我亲眼见过。

lines.en: So...I hope this has nothing to do with that.
lines.zh: : 所以……我希望这件事与此无关。

lines.en: And I hope that, whatever it is, both she and Rika will be okay.
lines.zh: : 也希望,无论是什么,Rin 和 Rika 都能安然无恙。

lines.en: I ring the bell once I get to Rika’s place. The lights above the doors that belong to Yuki and Imani are both out, so I guess she’s the only one around tonight.
lines.zh: : 到了 Rika 的住处,我按响门铃。Yuki 和 Imani 门上的灯都熄了,看来今晚只有她在。

lines.en: : Come in! It’s open!
lines.zh: : 进来!没锁!

lines.en: : Hey! Thanks for coming to me. People don’t really like it when I bring Frankenstein out in public.
lines.zh: : 嗨!谢谢你来看我。大家都不太喜欢我把 Frankenstein 带出门。

lines.en: : So you really kept it, huh?
lines.zh: : 所以你真的把它留下了,啊?

lines.en: : Of course! Just look at him. Who could ever turn away an adorable face like this?
lines.zh: : 当然!你看看它。谁能拒绝这样一张可爱的小脸?

lines.en: : Besides, if that thing Imani said about rats only living for three years is true, I want to make sure the last...however many years he has left are as good as they can be.
lines.zh: : 再说了,如果 Imani 说的「老鼠只能活三年」是真的,我想确保它剩下的……不管多少年,都过得尽可能好。

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad you and your son are happy together. And I’m also glad to see you actually have some furniture now.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我很高兴你和「你儿子」相处融洽。我也很高兴看到你终于有家具了。

lines.en: : It’s a work in progress. But all I really need is a futon and a table to eat stuff at.
lines.zh: : 一切都在进行中。但我真正需要的,就是一张蒲团和一张吃饭的桌子。

lines.en: : I see you kept the chalk outlines too.
lines.zh: : 我看到你把地上的粉笔人形轮廓也留下了。

lines.en: : They make good decorations. And I figured that if I ever have a heart attack or die of old age or something, I could just lie down on top of them and make life easier for whoever finds my body.
lines.zh: : 它们是很好的装饰。而且我想,万一我心脏病发、或者老死了什么的,直接往上面一躺,还能给发现我尸体的人省点事。

lines.en: : I think they only do the outlining thing for homicide investigations.
lines.zh: : 我记得只有凶杀案调查才会画轮廓。

lines.en: : I guess I just have to hope my potential murderer is as kind as me then, huh?
lines.zh: : 那我只好希望,我未来的谋杀者和我一样好心,啊?

lines.en: : Guess so, Rika.
lines.zh: : 大概吧,Rika。

lines.en: : So...that thing you wanted to talk about.
lines.zh: : 那么……你想聊的那件事。

lines.en: : Mhm?
: Mind filling me in now? Or were you only luring me over with your daughter’s name because you thought it would get me here quicker?
lines.zh: : 介意现在告诉我吗?还是说你拿女儿的名字当诱饵,只是觉得那样我能来得更快?

lines.en: : Why would I think that, Akira?
lines.zh: : 我为什么会那样想,Akira?

lines.en: : Because I’ve known her longer and care about her more than you.
lines.zh: : 因为我认识她更久,也在乎她更多。

lines.en: : Wow. Harsh.
lines.zh: : 哇。真狠。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll work your way up the rankings. But, as it stands, I’ve just been through way more with her.
lines.zh: : 我确信你会慢慢往上爬的。但就目前而言,我和她一起经历的,确实多得多。

lines.en: : It’s fine, I get it. I obviously also care about her more than you too.
lines.zh: : 没关系,我懂。显然,我在乎她的程度也超过你。

lines.en: : Rin is, to put it plainly...the greatest thing that’s ever happened to me. More than Rie. More than Frankenstein. Even more than that time I made out with Robert Plant when he played in Fukuoka in ‘96.
lines.zh: : 说白了,Rin 是……发生在我身上最美好的事。超过 Rie。超过 Frankenstein。甚至超过 96 年 Robert Plant 来福冈演出那晚我和他的热吻。

lines.en: : Well, I am very glad you like your daughter more than some rockstar’s tongue.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我很高兴你爱你的女儿胜过某位摇滚明星的舌头。

lines.en: : And I’m glad to hear you do too. Though, your opinion is obviously skewed since you’ve never made out with a rockstar.
lines.zh: : 我也很高兴你也一样。虽然你的判断明显有偏差——毕竟你从没和摇滚明星热吻过。

lines.en: : I’ve boned an idol, though. That has to count for something.
lines.zh: : 但我睡过偶像。这总该算数。

lines.en: : It does. That Niki girl’s super cute. But the point is, we both care about Rin and we both want what’s best for her. Right?
lines.zh: : 算。那个 Niki 确实超可爱。但重点是,我们都在乎 Rin,都想给她最好的。对吧?

lines.en: : Right.
: Good. Then let’s make a deal to be as blunt as possible from this point on so there are no misunderstandings at all about what we’re dealing with. Okay?
lines.zh: : 好。那我们约定,从现在起尽可能直来直去,这样对我们面对的事情就不会有任何误解。好吗?

lines.en: : Uhh...okay. I still don’t really get what’s happening, though.
lines.zh: : 呃……好。不过我还是不太明白现在是什么情况。

lines.en: : Do you remember the night when I took your phone?
lines.zh: : 你还记得我抢你手机的那晚吗?

lines.en: : Of course I remember. I could hardly walk the next day after learning what it meant to do it “Ghana style.”
lines.zh: : 当然记得。第二天我几乎走不动路——在领教了「加纳式」的含义之后。

lines.en: : Which isn’t even mentioning how hard it was for me to calm Ami down when I got home. I had to explain like ten times that I couldn’t answer her calls because of you.
lines.zh: : 更别提我到家后安抚 Ami 有多难。我不得不解释了差不多十遍,说没法接她电话都是因为你。

lines.en: : And I’m sorry for that, okay? I went into rabid mom mode and wasn’t thinking clearly.
lines.zh: : 为此我很抱歉,行吗?我当时切换进了狂暴妈妈模式,没冷静思考。

lines.en: : You told me you were using it as a flashlight to find a key you dropped in the sewer outside.
lines.zh: : 你告诉我,你拿它是当手电筒,找你掉在外面下水道里的钥匙。

lines.en: : Which was not a lie, actually. I did do that when I got back. But only for a couple minutes before I realized I could just use my own phone for that and yours was dying from Ami calling it so many times.
lines.zh: : 倒也不算撒谎。我回去后确实找过。但只找了几分钟——因为我意识到用自己的手机就行,而你的手机被 Ami 打到快没电了。

lines.en: : The full truth, though...
lines.zh: : 可完整的真相是……

lines.en: : Is that...
lines.zh: : 那就是……

lines.en: : Rin texted you.
lines.zh: : Rin 给你发过短信。

lines.en: : Many times, actually. Which is the only reason I picked your phone up in the first place since it wouldn’t stop going off and was really annoying me.
lines.zh: : 其实发了好多条。这也是我当初捡起你手机的唯一原因——它响个不停,烦死我了。

lines.en: : Did she? I don’t remember seeing anything.
lines.zh: : 有吗?我不记得看到过什么。

lines.en: : That’s because I deleted everything.
lines.zh: : 那是因为我全删了。

lines.en: : You...went through my messages?
lines.zh: : 你……看了我的短信?

lines.en: : Not all of them. I do respect your privacy despite the whole...thievery thing. It was only the stuff Rin sent that night that I got rid of. That’s all I saw.
lines.zh: : 没全看。尽管发生了整个……盗窃事件,我还是尊重你的隐私的。我只删了 Rin 那晚发来的东西。我看到的也只有那些。

lines.en: : Rika, I get why you’d be worried about that, and...you know, I guess it is technically inappropriate for me to have her number. But it’s not like I’m using it for nefarious purposes or anything.
lines.zh: : Rika,我理解你为什么会担心这个,而且……你知道,严格来说,我有她的号码确实不妥。但我并没有拿它做什么见不得人的事。

lines.en: : You already know I hang out at the dorms sometimes. And-
lines.zh: : 你知道我有时会去宿舍玩的。而且——

lines.en: : Akira, she...
lines.zh: : Akira,她……

lines.en: : The stuff she sent to you that night was so graphic that I don’t even want to repeat it.
lines.zh: : 那晚她发给你的东西,露骨到我不想复述。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : Be honest with me. As a parent, not a friend. Or...maybe as a friend if you find it easier to talk that way? Has Rin ever-
lines.zh: : 对我说实话。以家长的身份,而不是朋友。或者……如果那样更好开口,就当朋友?Rin 有没有——

lines.en: : Graphic how, Rika? What does that mean?
lines.zh: : 露骨到什么程度,Rika?什么意思?

lines.en: : Hah. Fine. I told you we should be blunt, so I’m going to be blunt. We can be mature about this.
lines.zh: : 哈。行。我说过我们要直来直去,那我就直说。我们可以成熟地谈这件事。

lines.en: : She sent you basically an entire essay about wanting to have sex with you, complete with a five minute video of her...you know.
lines.zh: : 她给你发的,基本上是一整篇「想和你做爱」的小作文,还附了一段五分钟的视频,内容是她……你懂的。

lines.en: : Rin did? You’re sure it was her?
lines.zh: : Rin 发的?你确定是她?

lines.en: : Yeah. I think I know my daughter when I see her.
lines.zh: : 确定。我认得自己的女儿。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : You’ve really...never gotten anything like that from her before?
lines.zh: : 你真的……从来没有收到过类似的东西?

lines.en: : No...never.
lines.zh: : 没有……从来没有。

lines.en: Not directly, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少没有这么直接的。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 我懂了……

lines.en: : I guess she wasn’t lying about literally everything then.
lines.zh: : 我猜,她那句「一切都很假」宣言里,倒也不全是假话。

lines.en: : So you just...believe me then? That’s it?
lines.zh: : 所以你就……这样信我了?就这样?

lines.en: : You don’t get expressive often. So when you do, it’s easy to tell exactly how you’re feeling. And I know confusion when I see it. I own a mirror.
lines.zh: : 你很少流露情绪。所以一旦流露,你到底什么感受一目了然。而困惑这种东西,我一眼就认得。我家有面镜子。

lines.en: : What...happened after that?
lines.zh: : 那……那之后发生了什么?

lines.en: : Well, after she invited you over to pound her with the intensity of a western silverback, which is a type of gorilla, I sent her a text from your phone saying I was on the way.
lines.zh: : 嗯,在她邀请你过去、要用「西部银背」的力度干她之后——那是一种大猩猩——我用你的手机回了条短信,说你在路上了。

lines.en: : Once I got there, she opened the door and...it was like a flip switched inside of me.
lines.zh: : 等我到了,她开了门,然后……我体内像有什么开关被扳动了。

lines.en: : I don’t get serious often. It hurts my head. But this girl, a girl I have nurtured and supported and admired for so many years...turned me into, like...a discipline robot with the snap of her fingers.
lines.zh: : 我很少严肃。严肃让我头疼。但这个女孩,这个我养育、支持、欣赏了这么多年的女孩……一个响指,就把我变成了一个……纪律机器人。

lines.en: : I took her phone...tried to warn her about what she was doing and how much trouble she could get you in by sending that stuff, but I don’t even know if I got through in the end.
lines.zh: : 我拿走了她的手机……试着警告她,让她明白自己在做什么、发那种东西会给你惹来多大麻烦,但我甚至不确定最后她听进去了没有。

lines.en: : It’s scary, you know? Like, I’m not going to think less of her for having a crush on her teacher. We’ve all done that. But never in a million years did I think she’d go out of her way to, like...try and rope you into it.
lines.zh: : 那很吓人,你知道吗?我是说,她暗恋自己的老师,我不会因此看轻她。我们都干过。但我万万没想到,她会主动……设法把你拖下水。

lines.en: : Like, where the hell did she get that from?
lines.zh: : 就是说,她那套到底是从哪学来的?

lines.en: : I have no idea...
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道……

lines.en: : Anyway, please don’t bring this up to her. I’ve embarrassed her enough and she’d straight up kill me if she found out I told you about this. I just need to know for sure that nothing’s going on.
lines.zh: : 总之,请别向她提起这件事。我已经让她够尴尬了,她要是发现我告诉了你,会直接杀了我。我只需要确认:你们之间什么都没有。

lines.en: : Yeah...of course...
: I’ve never even touched her.
lines.zh: : 我连碰都没碰过她。

lines.en: A lie, of course. But one worth telling as the single kiss I shared with her amounted to little more than false hope and a few bundles of tissues.
lines.zh: : 一个谎言,当然。但值得说——因为我和她的唯一一次吻,带来的不过是虚假的希望和几团纸巾。

lines.en: Rika can’t know I’ll never forget it, though. Not when she’s already suspicious.
lines.zh: : 不过 Rika 不能知道我永远忘不掉那件事。尤其在她已经起疑的现在。

lines.en: That was so long ago, now.
lines.zh: : 那已经是很久以前了。

lines.en: I doubt it even crosses her mind.
lines.zh: : 我怀疑它甚至不会掠过她的脑海。

lines.en: : Did you even know she felt this way about you?
lines.zh: : 你根本知道她对你有这种感觉吗?

lines.en: : I thought she felt the exact opposite way about me. She’s been obsessed with girls the entire time I’ve known her.
lines.zh: : 我一直以为她对我的感觉截然相反。自我认识她起,她眼里就只有女孩。

lines.en: : Well, I guess it’s your turn then. Because I doubt this is going to just go away overnight. Rin has so much love to give, that’s why it always, like...overflows whenever she finds somebody.
lines.zh: : 嗯,那我猜该轮到你了。因为我不觉得这会一夜之间烟消云散。Rin 有那么多的爱要给,所以每次她找到某个人,那些爱总是……泛滥成灾。

lines.en: : At the very least, she knows it’s wrong. You know it’s wrong. That’s not going to stop the way she feels, though. She needs...I don’t know. She needs something.
lines.zh: : 至少,她知道这是错的。你也知道这是错的。但那不会阻止她的感受。她需要……我不知道。她需要某样东西。

lines.en: : Like, I don’t want to tell you go break the girl’s heart or anything because I don’t want her, like...romantically traumatized or stunted by a grown man telling her to back off. She doesn’t even know you know yet.
lines.zh: : 比如我不想让你去伤这姑娘的心什么的,因为我不希望她……被一个成年男人叫她退开而留下浪漫创伤、或者发育受阻。她甚至不知道你已经知道了。

lines.en: : So my only idea is, like...wait for it to blow over? But that sounds too passive and her other mom agrees. Just neither of us knows what the best course of action is right now, so...
lines.zh: : 所以我唯一的想法就是……等它自己过去?但这听起来太消极了,她另一位妈妈也同意。只是我们俩都不知道现在最好的做法是什么,所以……

lines.en: : At least you’re in the know now. So if she ever comes at you again, just...let her down gently, okay? That’s my baby girl. She’s just...being a little dumb right now.
lines.zh: : 至少你现在知情了。所以她要是再向你扑过来,你就……温和地拒绝,好吗?那是我的宝贝女儿。她只是……眼下有点犯蠢。

lines.en: : She gets it from me, I guess.
lines.zh: : 她那点随我,我猜。

lines.en: : You’re a great mom, Rika. Don’t let yourself think otherwise.
lines.zh: : 你是个很棒的妈妈,Rika。别让你自己往别处想。

lines.en: : You should see Rie. She’s like a...mom magician. A momgician. A...mom...
lines.zh: : 你该看看 Rie。她就像个……妈妈魔法师。妈妈术师。一个……妈妈……

lines.en: : Aaah! Now I want to cry again!
lines.zh: : 啊!我又想哭了!

lines.en: : You still really miss her, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你还是很想她,对吧?

lines.en: : Yeah, but...
lines.zh: : 想,但是……

lines.en: : More than that, I think I just miss being loved all together.
lines.zh: : 比这更重要的是,我想念的是「被一整个爱的人围绕」的感觉。

lines.en: : Wakana has Osako. Imani has you. Who does that leave me with? A rat? Who’s going to love me this late in life, Akira? Nobody.
lines.zh: : Wakana 有 Osako。Imani 有你。那还剩下谁?一只老鼠?到了人生这个阶段,还有谁会爱我,Akira?没有人。

lines.en: : Question — have you tried witchcraft?
lines.zh: : 问一句——你试过巫术吗?

lines.en: : Of course I’ve tried witchcraft. They’d have revoked my lesbian license by now if I hadn’t. Still nothing, though.
lines.zh: : 我当然试过巫术。不试的话,我的女同执照早就被吊销了。依然毫无收获。

lines.en: : You’ll find someone, I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 你会找到人的,我确信。

lines.en: : How do you know that, though?
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道?

lines.en: : Because you’re extremely fucking hot, Rika. Like, disturbingly so.
lines.zh: : 因为你极度他妈的火辣,Rika。火辣到令人不安的程度。

lines.en: : Aww, thank you! Now I’m in a good mood again.
lines.zh: : 哎呀,谢谢!我现在心情又好了。

lines.en: : Mmm but now I’m sad again because I’m remembering my daughter wants to fuck old people.
lines.zh: : 唔,但现在我又难过了,因为我想起我女儿想睡老年人。

lines.en: : Could be worse. My daughter specifically only wants to have sex with me.
lines.zh: : 还有更糟的。我女儿只「专门」想和我做。

lines.en: : Rin wanted to marry Rie when she was younger. Maybe it’s just a daughter thing?
lines.zh: : Rin 小时候想嫁给 Rie。也许这只是女儿们的通病?

lines.en: : Did you ever want to have sex with either of your parents?
lines.zh: : 你有想过和你的父母任何一位做吗?

lines.en: : No. But my uncle grabbed my boob once. He said it was an accident, but I never believed him. He’s dead now though, so my boobs are finally safe.
lines.zh: : 没有。但我叔叔摸过我的胸一次。他说是意外,但我从来不信。不过他现在死了,所以我的胸终于安全了。

lines.en: : I’m happy for you, Rika. I’m happy for your boobs too.
lines.zh: : 为你高兴,Rika。也为你的胸高兴。

lines.en: : Awww! Are you actually smiling?!
lines.zh: : 哎呀!你居然在笑?!

lines.en: : Trying to. I’m still learning.
lines.zh: : 在尝试。我还在学。

lines.en: : Hahah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……

lines.en: : We never really stop learning, do we?
lines.zh: : 我们从来都不会停止学习,对吧?

lines.en: : Even now, at 42 years old, I’m learning things about my daughter. About how to deal with new...weird problems I never expected. And I’ve already dealt with so much for her, you know?
lines.zh: : 直到今天,42 岁的我还在了解我的女儿。在学习怎么应对从没料到的新……怪问题。而我已经为她操了那么多心,你知道吗?

lines.en: : Depression’s no joke, dude. It took us so long to find a therapist that she actually clicked with. It was like one of those...what do you call it, again? Oh! Noodle in a haystack.
lines.zh: : 抑郁症不是开玩笑的,伙计。我们花了特别久,才找到一个她真正「合拍」的心理医生。就像那种……你管那个叫什么来着?哦!大海捞针——捞「面条」。

lines.en: : Needle.
: Needle? No. A noodle would be harder to find. It won’t poke you.
lines.zh: : 针?不对。面条才更难找。面条又不会戳到你。

lines.en: : You’re...not wrong?
lines.zh: : 你……说的……好像也对?

lines.en: : Oh no! I killed the smile. Bring it back!
lines.zh: : 哦不!我把笑容弄没了!把它拿回来!

lines.en: : I can only manage it for a few seconds at a time. Don’t take it personally.
lines.zh: : 我一次只能维持几秒钟。别往心里去。

lines.en: : Oh, I won’t. Not taking things personally is my specialty when I am the legal guardian of a hormonal gremlin who keeps adding a year to my age. The joys of parenting, am I right?
lines.zh: : 哦,我不会的。不当真本来就是我的特长——毕竟我是一个法定监护着一个「每年给我年龄上加一岁」的荷尔蒙小妖精的人。为人父母的乐趣,对吧?

lines.en: : I’m still new to that too. I wouldn’t really know.
lines.zh: : 我在这行也是新人。我没有发言权。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : You’re doing a great job though, Akira.
lines.zh: : 不过你干得很棒,Akira。

lines.en: : How would you even know? You’ve never seen me in action.
lines.zh: : 你怎么会知道?你又没见过我实战。

lines.en: : Ami called you like five hundred times the night I had your phone. I’m lucky if Rin calls me once per week.
lines.zh: : 我拿走你手机的那晚,Ami 给你打了差不多五百个电话。而 Rin 一周能给我打一个,我就谢天谢地了。

lines.en: : Ami’s different.
lines.zh: : Ami 不一样。

lines.en: : Ami loves you.
lines.zh: : Ami 爱你。

lines.en: : For good reason, too. Deep beneath all that anguish and torment in that lake of sorrow you call your heart, there’s a caring, gentle little boy who just wants the people he loves to be happy.
lines.zh: : 而且有充分的理由。在你那颗被你称作心脏的悲伤之湖,在那片痛苦与折磨的深处,藏着一个温柔的、有爱心的小男孩——他只希望他爱的人幸福。

lines.en: : Lake of Sorrow is an album by Sins of Thy Beloved.
lines.zh: : 《Lake of Sorrow》是 Sins of Thy Beloved 乐队的专辑。

lines.en: : You remember.
lines.zh: : 你记得。

lines.en: : I remember all sorts of things. But I forget even more.
lines.zh: : 我记得各种各样的事。但我忘掉的更多。

lines.en: : Those sound like lyrics. Are you trying to start a band right now?
lines.zh: : 这话听着像歌词。你是想现在组团出道吗?

lines.en: : I’m not sure either one of us has the time between dealing with our respective daughters and how horny they are for me.
lines.zh: : 我们俩一边要对付各自的女儿、和她们对我的饥渴,一边恐怕谁也挤不出时间。

lines.en: : I’m horny for you too, Akira.
lines.zh: : 我对你也很饥渴,Akira。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 你说什么?

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : Did you just-
lines.zh: : 你刚才是不是——

lines.en: : Yeah.
: And was that-
lines.zh: : 那刚刚那是——

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Uhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃啊啊……

lines.en: : I’ve won over like twenty girls with that move. Blatant admission and direct eye contact.
lines.zh: : 这一招我拿下了差不多二十个女孩。坦白承认+直接对视。

lines.en: : Yeah, you haven’t blinked once.
lines.zh: : 是,你一次眼都没眨。

lines.en: : That’s how you know I’m serious.
lines.zh: : 这就说明我是认真的。

lines.en: : Are you serious?
lines.zh: : 你是认真的?

lines.en: : If I said yes, what would you do?
lines.zh: : 我说是的话,你会怎么做?

lines.en: : Fuck you.
lines.zh: : 干你。

lines.en: : Bzzzt! You’re torn between my best friend and a famous pop star. Both of which are much smarter and cuter than me. Do not be tricked by my vast experience and feminine wiles.
lines.zh: : 嘀!你在我的挚友和一位著名流行歌星之间摇摆。她们俩都比我又聪明又可爱。可别被我丰富的经验和女性的千般手段迷惑了。

lines.en: : Also, do you have any idea how much it would fuck Rin up if she found out her mom had sex with the boy she likes?
lines.zh: : 还有,你知不知道,要是 Rin 发现她妈妈睡了「她喜欢的男孩」,她会崩成什么样?

lines.en: : She actually told me to have sex with you once.
lines.zh: : 她其实有一次让我和你做。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么?为什么?

lines.en: : To fix you, I think?
lines.zh: : 为了「修好你」,我猜?

lines.en: : Good reason. It would definitely help.
lines.zh: : 理由充分。那确实有帮助。

lines.en: : You’re doing the eye thing again.
lines.zh: : 你又开始使那个眼神了。

lines.en: : Oh, you don’t need to tell me. I’m well aware of what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 哦,不用你提醒。我很清楚自己在做什么。

lines.en: : I-Imani! It’s not what it looks like! We were just-
lines.zh: : 我——Imani!不是你看到的那样!我们只是——
